stance_rationale: This is an architecture/protocol draft with draft_marker=true, alpha_vector empty, diagnostics null, and no emitted alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, or covariance.parquet at the required paths. The package can be reviewed as a design note, but it cannot pass an alpha-package critique under RF-A1~A7, PIT C1~C15, or AX-008 evidence requirements.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Required alpha_scores.parquet is absent from qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260519_001 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260519_001; stage dir B contains only design docs, so Date x Ticker x score schedule cannot be verified.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Z_Score_Aligned is asserted in docs, but no factor_engine_proposal.R, executable loader trace, or emitted alpha artifact proves absence of NEGATE_FACTORS/manual sign flip.
ic_history.parquet is pending Forge emit; Usable_Date <= sig_date cannot be verified.
load_month_factors() routing is asserted, but no implementation artifact or lineage log proves connector use over direct parquet loading.
The current design states no DD/VT/regime overlay is used; optional m4 usage would require a separate t-1 lag audit if enabled.
Fundamental lag compliance is inherited by assertion from Factor DB registry; no emitted feature panel or loader log verifies annual May/quarterly 45d lag in this WT.

critical_concerns.description: The required artifact set is missing: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260519_001 do not exist for this task, so RF-A7 time-series alpha, schedule, and PSD/condition checks are impossible.
All alpha diagnostics are null and explicitly deferred to Forge, so rank_IC >= 0.04, ICIR >= 0.20, Harvey t >= 3.0, DSR, monotonicity, and sub_stability cannot pass the role checklist.
weights.csv is absent, so top-20, long-only, [0,0.20] bounds, sum(weights)=1, HHI non-collapse, turnover < 600% annual, and LIQ_20d >= 2e8 cannot be verified on a per-sig_date schedule.
AX-007 ML-sizing exemption is claimed as eligible before demonstration; without weights and HHI, the prior v1 EW-collapse failure mode remains live for a single-sleeve long-only top-20 design.
PIT compliance is mostly assertion-level: C14 is pending, C15 has no executable lineage, C4 lag is inherited by claim, and lookahead_detector.R has not been run on emitted artifacts.
Charter §8 No Silent Override is not satisfied: challenge_note is pending, artifact_lineage.json is absent, and RF-A1~A7 have not been disposed in a post-Codex record.
The package proposes reducing DSR n_trials from 100 to 50 if DSR < 1.5; changing the deflator after seeing failure is a multiple-testing/data-mining concern, not a valid mitigation.

Academic-reference audit has material mismatches: arXiv:2104.12484 is a long-short China A-share paper with different title/date framing, arXiv:2405.15833 authors/title differ from the package, and the claimed You-Zhang 2025 RFS core reference was not found in spot search, weakening Charter §4 mechanism evidence.

supporting_arguments: The draft is at least explicit that metrics are pending and does not fabricate IC/SR/DSR numbers; this reduces AX-002 severity but does not make the alpha package passable.
Stage dir B contains literature, architecture, PIT audit, training, and admission protocols, so the design intent is reviewable even though executable artifacts are missing.

Primary-source spot checks used: https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.12484, https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15833, https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11243, https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05975, https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01176.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a is allowed to waive the base-context requirement that every alpha_package emit time-series alpha_scores.parquet.
Whether 52 planned test months is sufficient against the role prompt's >=60 sig_dates recommendation, especially with no artifact emitted.
Whether defensive-heavy top-20 DPL can satisfy AX-005 and AX-007 after real weights, not just by architectural eligibility.
Whether Factor DB routing and fundamental lags are actually enforced in code rather than inherited by assertion.
Whether covariance.parquet PSD and condition <=100 can be verified by a later risk package, since no current covariance artifact exists.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that a design-only draft with null diagnostics and absent alpha/weight/covariance artifacts can be treated as an alpha package by inheriting discovery_design_phase_a rather than emitting verifiable time-series alpha evidence.
rebuttal_required: Emit alpha_scores.parquet with Date/sig_date x Ticker x score, multi-sig_date schedule, last date <= current date, and schema/row-count audit.
Emit weights.csv and prove per-sig_date top-20, long-only, [0,0.20], sum=1, HHI > 0.06, turnover < 6.0 annual, and LIQ_20d >= 2e8.
Emit ic_history.parquet and diagnostics for rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, sub_stability, monotonicity, and sector-neutral IC retention.
Provide executable lineage proving load_month_factors() routing, Usable_Date <= sig_date, fundamental lags, and lookahead_detector.R PASS.
Provide challenge_note and artifact_lineage.json with RF-A1~A7 disposition and write_json -> record_lineage order.
Correct academic citations with exact paper metadata, page/section support, and KR transfer evidence.
rationalization_red_flags: Auto-flag terms appear in self-check/list text rather than substantive justification: 미미, 관행적, 보수적이면 OK, 대부분 결과 동일, 이미 반영되어 있었을 것.
Non-base but material rationalization: If DSR < 1.5 reduce n_trials to 50.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The alpha draft marks AX-008 as pending, but from a critic standpoint 0/3 evidence plus missing Forge/Architect artifacts is a current FAIL, not a pass-with-caveats.

alpha_specific_questions: Can this factor maintain t_NW > 2.95/3.0 in a fund-of-fund environment after 15bps one-way cost and DSR deflation?
Is the alpha vector time series free of future leakage, especially for fundamentals and any optional regime inputs?
If the package relies on AX-007 ML-sizing exemption, where is the realized weights/HHI evidence proving exemption sufficiency rather than mere eligibility?
Why should DSR n_trials be reducible after failure rather than pre-registered before training?
